Question 16
?

The graph shows a portion of the curve y=sec⁡x and the line y=−2. Which of the following generates the x-values of all of their points of intersection? Assume that n is an integer.

a
x=60∘+n⋅360∘,x=300∘+n⋅360∘
b
x=60∘+n⋅360∘,x=120∘+n⋅360∘
c
x=60∘+n⋅180∘
d
x=120∘+n⋅360∘,x=240∘+n⋅360∘
e
x=120∘+n⋅180∘
